_doc: HAZARD REGISTRY — the machine-readable census of confirmed hazard classes.
⚠ PROVENANCE, AND THE TRANSITION THAT ROTS SUCH FILES ⚠
This file was DERIVED FROM MEASUREMENT on its first write (2026-08-07, at build
sha bd5e49f6 on claude/composite-r4): every `enforcer.paths` entry was verified
to exist on disk, every `status` came from a read of the named enforcer, and the
baselined-red downgrades were read out of scripts/.test-ratchet-baseline.json.
FROM THIS COMMIT ONWARD IT IS A HAND-MAINTAINED FILE. That transition is exactly
where an artifact like this rots: the numbers stop being measurements and become
transcriptions nobody re-derives. scripts/check-hazard-registry.mjs exists to make
the rot REDDEN rather than accumulate — it re-derives `enforcer.inChain` from
package.json on every run and reds on a mismatch, and it re-checks every named
path against the filesystem. Fields it CANNOT derive (`instances`, prose) are
still documents and are marked as such in `instanceEvidence`.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The owner's observation: recorded hazard cures keep failing
because a recorded cure is a DOCUMENT, and a document needs someone to read it at
exactly the right moment while doing something else. Proof from a single day: the
config-slot trap was recorded WITH its exact cure and a lane walked into it; the
piped-exit-code hazard is recorded and the chair hit it twice while briefing others
against it. THE RULE THIS ENCODES: every confirmed hazard class either becomes
MACHINERY, or is EXPLICITLY ACCEPTED as a document with a stated reason.
AND THE TRAP THIS FILE MUST NOT COMMIT: that rule is itself a document. So the
registry's own integrity is GATE-ENFORCED (npm run validate:hazard-registry, step
one of `npm run check`) and its failure paths are EXERCISED by
tests/lint/hazardRegistryFailClosed.test.js rather than asserted.
STATUS VOCABULARY (closed set — an entry with any other value, or none, REDS):
MACHINERY — an enforcer exists that REDS on a new instance without anyone
remembering the hazard. Requires non-empty enforcer.paths, all of
which must exist on disk.
PARTIAL   — an enforcer exists but can be bypassed, is baselined red, is scoped
narrower than the class, or must be invoked on purpose.
DOCUMENT  — the cure is written down and nothing enforces it. This is the OWED
pile, and `documentBaseline` below is a SHRINK-ONLY ratchet on it.
ACCEPTED  — deliberately left as a document, WITH a stated reason in
`acceptedReason`. An acceptance without a reason is a silent
surrender and REDS.
documentBaseline is EXACT-SHRINK-ONLY: the owed pile may only get smaller. Moving
a class DOCUMENT -> PARTIAL/MACHINERY/ACCEPTED lowers the count and the baseline is
lowered with it in the same commit. Adding a new DOCUMENT class REDS until either
an enforcer is built or the class is ACCEPTED with a reason — which is the ratchet
on the treadmill itself.
classFloor is a SCOPE SENTINEL: a registry that collapses below it fails loudly
rather than passing vacuously with nothing to check.

classes.title: A launched task lands on the wrong lineage/worktree

enforcer.note: No repo-side guard exists. The cure is a hard-gate first clause in every state-mutating compound.

classes.instanceEvidence: CONFIRMED by count at census time: 11 'Recurrence' headings in wrong-lineage-worktree-trap-2026-07-14.md; preview-tool-serves-main-tree.md self-labels 'Recurrence #10 … via a NEW vector'; e0-tempo-governor-shipped.md labels itself recurrence #4. The recorded cure IS effective when applied — the failure is that applying it is voluntary.

first state-mutating git command of a session
any bash command after a turn boundary (cwd resets)
preview_start / dev-server launch
classes.upgradePath: THE #1 TREADMILL: highest instance count in the estate and ZERO machinery. Ship scripts/assert-lineage.sh taking an expected branch and exiting non-zero on mismatch, and emit its invocation from the briefing template so the guard is the first clause rather than a remembered one.

classes.title: Reading a gate through a pipe returns the PIPE's exit 0, not the gate's

enforcer.note: gate-tail.sh COMPLETELY solves it and is routed around by hand-rolled pipelines. A cure you can bypass is a document wearing a tool's clothes. ⚠ CENSUS CORRECTION (this lane, bd5e49f6): the census named 'scripts/check-tail.sh' as an enforcer — that file DOES NOT EXIST. The npm script `check:tail` is `sh scripts/gate-tail.sh npm run check`; there is one script, not two. This is HZ-DERIVERESTATE inside the census itself, and it is exactly what check-hazard-registry.mjs now reds on.

classes.instanceEvidence: CONFIRMED: three bites recorded in piped-gate-exit-masking.md (2026-07-17; 2026-07-26 `npm run check:edge-behavior | tail`; 2026-07-27 pre-push). backup-exposure-2026-07-26.md records two more. hazard-conversion-law.md: 'it fired FOUR times that day, twice by the chair, while the chair was briefing others against it.'
triggers: any shell command containing `| tail`, `| head`, `| grep` whose exit status is then read
any compound whose LAST pipeline segment is not the command under test
any brief instructing an agent to run a gate
classes.upgradePath: THE CANONICAL PARTIAL, named as such by the owner. Mechanisable as a scan of agent-authored command logs, or by making the bare pipeline unavailable (a shell function shadowing `tail` in the gate environment).

classes.title: Un-anchored negative assertions and bare seed loops (tests that cannot fail)

enforcer.note: ✔ NO LONGER BASELINED (2026-08-07). The four walker rows were REMOVED from scripts/.test-ratchet-baseline.json and each walker's own shrink-only inventory was re-frozen at 36e50c73 instead, so a NEW un-anchored negative or bare seed loop REDS THE GATE AGAIN. Generation-facing re-admissions live in a separate READMITTED_GENERATION_FACING quarantine audited by EXACT identity — a new file reds, growth reds, and an un-banked shrink reds. ⛔ NEVER RE-ADD A WALKER ROW TO THE TEST CENSUS: a failing TEST is debt, a failing WALKER is a disabled guard, and the two may not share one freezing mechanism.

classes.instanceEvidence: MEASURED 2026-08-07 by each walker's own UPDATE_EPISTEMIC_ALLOWLIST regeneration inside an integrity-counted `git archive` of 36e50c73 (6,196 paths in, 6,196 out): 519 files / 1,565 un-anchored negative assertions, and 18 files / 26 bare seed loops. ⚠⚠ BOTH GREW WHILE THE ROWS WERE BASELINED — 1,303 → 1,565 sites and 13 → 26 loops against the inventories actually frozen in the walkers — which is HZ-REDRATCHETGROWS observed live: a tolerated failing row is byte-identical however much worse the tree gets.
triggers: any new or edited file under tests/domain/, tests/generators/, tests/copy/, tests/simulation/
any test adding `.not.toMatch`/`.not.toContain`
any test adding a `for (const seed of ...)` loop
classes.upgradePath: ENFORCEMENT IS RESTORED; THE HABITAT IS NOT CLEARED, which is why this stays PARTIAL rather than MACHINERY. Reaching MACHINERY is a burn-down of the two frozen inventories to empty — anchor each site via tests/helpers/anchoredNegatives.js, route each loop through tests/helpers/seedFailures.js — not new design. Priority order: empty READMITTED_GENERATION_FACING first (3 files / 5 sites, and 1 file / 2 loops), because that restores the EP-2/EP-6 four-tree zero this lane had to relax in order to record it honestly.

classes.title: The shipped dist is un-bootable with every gate green (chunk-cycle TDZ)

enforcer.note: ⚠ `smoke:boot` appears EXACTLY ONCE in package.json — its own script definition. It is NOT among the steps of `npm run check`. The only guard for 'build exits 0 while dist cannot boot' is on-demand.

classes.instanceEvidence: MEASURED at bd5e49f6: the `check` chain is validate:data → validate:custom-content-manifest → validate:migration-head → validate:edge → validate:map → validate:tuning-bands → validate:foundry-module → validate:mcp-server → typecheck:ratchet → typecheck:domain:strict → lint → test:ratchet → build → verify:dist. `smoke:boot` is absent. classes.title: `ps aux | grep -c "[v]itest"` SELF-MATCHES — a phantom holder burns 40 minutes per gate

enforcer.note: PARTIAL BY CONSTRUCTION — an optional script competing against a one-liner everyone already knows. Never counts, excludes its own ancestry, PRINTS pid lines.

classes.title: A mutant that plants nothing GREENS — the probe passes without ever changing the file

enforcer.note: VERIFIED AT HEAD: check_caught grades BROKEN when `git diff --quiet -- "$file"` shows the target unchanged, emitting 'mutation did not apply — … stale anchor?'. Deliberately NOT keyed to a line number here: a `<file>.sh:<n>` address would plant an HZ-LINEADDR instance in the registry that names it. ⚠ The guard covers the SWEEP; a hand-run mutant outside the sweep is unguarded, and the sweep is not in the check chain.

classes.instanceEvidence: CONFIRMED for the guard's existence and text (read at bd5e49f6). ⚠ THE INSTANCE COUNT IS CARRIED FROM A TRUNCATED CENSUS ROW and is the one figure in this file NOT re-derived by this lane — treat it as a floor owing re-measurement, not a measurement.
triggers: any hand-run mutation probe outside scripts/mutation-sweep.sh
any new check_caught plant whose perl/sed anchor is hand-written
any refactor that moves a line a standing plant anchors on
classes.upgradePath: Extend the changed-a-line precondition beyond the sweep: every mutant claimed in a wave receipt should be provable by a diff, not by narration.

classes.title: A NEW un-baselined source file carries an implicit ZERO error ceiling — and a net-zero TOTAL hides it

enforcer.note: Both tsc ratchets are PER-FILE, never total. A file ABSENT from the baseline has a ceiling of ZERO, so a new module may not introduce a single error. ⚠ A per-file tsc run against the new file is a VACUUM (receipt-vacuity law) — run the ratchet, never tsc on one file.

classes.instanceEvidence: CONFIRMED from the landed commit message of f16de756, the repair for the two files 67f8a58e added: 'THE NET WAS ZERO AND THE RATCHET STILL CAUGHT IT. Full-config total was 177 before and 177 after 67f8a58e — the two new errors were offset by two the same commit removed elsewhere. A TOTAL-count ratchet would have passed this silently; the per-file zero-ceiling law for un-baselined files is the only reason it reds.' The cure landed AT THE SOURCE (an intersection narrowing on the validator), not at the use site and not by widening the baseline.
triggers: any file ADDED under a root listed in the full-typecheck baseline's own roots list
any rename whose DESTINATION path is absent from both tsc baselines
any edit to a file carrying an exact per-file error ceiling in either baseline
any decomposition or leaf-extraction wave, which creates un-baselined modules by construction
classes.upgradePath: Already MACHINERY and already in the gate chain, so the residual risk is human rather than mechanical: the reflex on a red is to ADD the new file to the baseline, which converts a caught defect into banked debt. scripts/premortem.mjs names this class the moment a new source file appears in a changeset, so the author meets the rule BEFORE the gate does.
